query: INSERT INTO job_item (org_id, id, job_id, mapping_id, idempotency_key, state, created_at, operation, subject_kind, subject_url, subject_numeric_id, state_from, state_to, requires_bound_on, marketplace) SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'queued', $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, m.marketplace FROM mapping m WHERE m.org_id = $1 AND m.id = $4
